note: Battle Drama Engine, slice 1: trainer dialogue. Lines are picked deterministically (no gameplay RNG). Placeholders: {name} the trainer's Pokémon, {foe} yours, {move} the move, {trainer} the trainer. Frequency: 'off' and 'low' only hide lines (low keeps major and climactic ones); decisions and records never depend on the setting.

voices.brash: Loud, proud, always sure it is winning.
voices.gentle: Warm and caring toward its Pokémon.
voices.grim: Cold and driven by old grudges.
voices.cheerful: Easygoing, treats it as a game.

brash: Hope you brought your best, because I did!
gentle: Let's do our best together, {name}.
I hope we can have a good battle.
calm: I have been watching how you play.
Let's see if you are as good as you look.
grim: You will not leave here the same.
cheerful: Oh, a battle! Let's make it fun!

gentle: You can do it, {name}!
Stay with me, {name}.
Please, {name}, use {move}!
{move}, with all your heart!

brash: Ha! That is how it is done!
gentle: Oh! That hit just right!
Wonderful, {name}!
calm: A lucky break. I will take it.

gentle: Are you all right, {name}?
Hang on, {name}!
You did so well, {name}. Rest now.
Thank you, {name}.
I'm sorry about that. It was a good fight.
Well fought, {foe}.

brash: Time to bring out the real star!
gentle: Come back, and thank you. Your turn!
Take a breather, I'm counting on you.
grim: I will not lose to this.

brash: No way, no way, not like this!
gentle: Please, {name}, just a little longer!
We can still do this, together!
calm: I am running out of options.
grim: Not yet. Not while I can still stand.
cheerful: Uh oh! Okay, okay, deep breath!

gentle: You are good. Really good.
I can see how much you trust {foe}.
calm: You rely on that a lot, don't you?

brash: I... lost? Next time it will be different!
gentle: That was a wonderful battle. Thank you.
You and your team are special.
calm: Your approach works. I will study it.
grim: Enjoy it. It will not last.

gentle: Don't be discouraged. You'll get stronger.
Thank you for battling us.
cheerful: Great battle! Let's do it again!

brash: Last time you beat me. I have been training ever since!
You humiliated me once. Not twice.
gentle: We lost to you before. We have grown, you know.
I remember our last battle. It made us better.
calm: Last time you beat me. I studied every turn.
I replayed our last battle a hundred times.
grim: You beat me once. I have not forgotten.
Every day I thought of how you won.
cheerful: Hey, it's you! You beat us last time! Round two!
Rematch! Last time was close, wasn't it?

brash: I beat you before and I will do it again!
gentle: I hope you are doing well since we last met.
Last time was tough on you. Let's both do our best.
calm: I won before. I will not assume it repeats.
Your last defeat taught you something. Show me.
grim: You lost to me once. You will again.
Last time was not even my best.
cheerful: Hey, I beat you last time! No hard feelings, right?

gentle: Hang in there, {name}, I'm right here.
Oh no, {name}! Be strong!
calm: A setback. It can be managed.
cheerful: Whoops, that's a bad one! Still fun though!
Ha, I did not plan for that!

brash: Feel that? That's what I call pressure!
Not so tough now, are you?
gentle: I'm sorry, {foe}, but we have to win.
Good work, {name}. Keep the pressure gentle but steady.
Oh, that was close, {name} is fine!
That's okay, try again!

brash: Pfft, I meant to do that!
Lucky dodge! It won't happen twice!
gentle: It's all right, {name}, breathe and try again.
No harm done, {name}.

brash: Still standing! I told you, nobody beats us!
gentle: {name}, you held on! I'm so proud!
You did it, {name}, just a bit longer!
calm: One hit away. I have not lost yet.
grim: It is not over until I say it is.
I did not come this far to fall now.
cheerful: Hang on, hang on, we are still in this!

brash: Walk it off, {name}! That's all you've got?
That hurt, but we hit back harder!
gentle: It's okay, {name}. You're doing great.
I believe in you, {name}!
calm: Stay calm, {name}. Look for the opening.
grim: Pain means you are still fighting.
cheerful: Ow, that stings! Shake it off!

brash: Something is stirring in {name}! Just you wait!
{name} is almost there... you will regret waiting!
gentle: {name}... I can feel it changing. Hold on a little longer.
Easy, {name}. Your moment is coming.
calm: The change in {name} is close. Noted.
grim: {name} is on the edge of something. You will not like it.
cheerful: Whoa, {name} is glowing! Something is happening!
{name}, you feel it too, right? Almost there!

opening: {name}, we do this together, as always.
Stay close, {name}. We have never lost sight of each other.
ownKo: {name} gave everything. Rest now, my friend.
desperation: Hold on, {name}! I am right here with you!
defeat: We lost, but we lost side by side. I would not trade that.
victory: That is what trust does. We did it together.

opening: Do not make me regret trusting you, {name}.
ownKo: Another failure. Get back in the ball.
desperation: Is that all you have? Move, {name}!
defeat: Tch. I should have trained harder.
victory: Finally. That is how it should always be.

opening: I have studied your team. Let us see if it was enough.
A battle worth taking seriously. Begin.
defeat: You have earned my respect. Do not lose it.
victory: A good battle. You will be stronger next time.

opening: I will not hold back, even for a friend!
Friends or not, {name} is going all out!
defeat: Heh, I guess a friend had to be the one to beat me.
victory: Sorry, friend. We will get stronger together.

opening: Every defeat led me back to you.
defeat: This is not the end of it. It never is.

opening: A {type} specialist, hm? I have prepared for your kind.

win: Your {move} decided that. I will remember it.
You leaned on {move} all battle. It worked. Next time I will counter it.
Keep that up and {foe} will carry you far. Do not stop now.
lose: You gave {move} a good try. Train and come back.
{foe} had heart. Lose today, learn tomorrow.
Do not be discouraged. Even {move} needs the right moment.

lastStand: {name}, give it everything we have left!
This is it, {name}. One more push!
finisher: Now, {name}! Show them what we trained for!
